title: Mavlink_NoSend passive mode
current_gap: The side effects of passive reception, whether any response is permitted, and the reference evidence for both are undefined; a packet capture proving the send constraint does not exist.

atoms.name: passive_receive_semantics
atoms.required: Pinned side-effect semantics of passive reception (state visibility, no commands)

atoms.name: response_policy
atoms.required: Explicit policy whether heartbeats/ACKs are permitted, with reference evidence

atoms.name: send_constraint_proof
atoms.required: Packet capture proving zero outbound datagrams for the mode duration

atoms.name: owned_receive_path
atoms.required: Owned receive-side seams remain bounded; the observer/relay paths are receive evidence, not NoSend proof

scope_rule: receive-only is proven by capture, not by configuration intent; an unproven NoSend mode is indistinguishable from Full

followups.blocked_by: Reference evidence on passive side effects and responses
Capture tooling on the bounded path

preserved.observer: owned receive seams exist; not NoSend proof
